subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which open linked macOS PR should be the canonical fix path for the dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same auth fallback behavior and differ on parser parity, proof, or whether they fix only the symptom.

options.title: Review and land the strongest native fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has refreshed current-head real macOS app proof and maintainer acceptance of the compatibility edge.

options.title: Choose another linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use another open linked PR if it provides better end-to-end proof, cleaner upgrade behavior, or a narrower owner-boundary fix.

options.title: Ask for a replacement if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and create a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be made landable.

recommendation.title: Review and land the strongest native fallback PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has refreshed current-head real macOS app proof and maintainer acceptance of the compatibility edge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest macOS dashboard and GatewayEndpointStore history among the traced candidates for this native app decision.
